en: As of 2026, Bukidnon State University (BukSU) has a team of vice presidents specializing in different areas rather than a single vice president. Key officials include:
Vice President for Academic Affairs: Dr. Hazel Jean M. Abejuela
Vice President for Research, Extension and Innovations: Dr. Carina Joane V. Barroso
Vice President for Administration and Finance: Mr. Dante S. Victoria, Jr.
Vice President for Culture, Arts, Sports and Student Services: Dr. Lincoln V. Tan
Dr. Joy M. Mirasol serves as the University President.
for more Information you can visit the Official BukSU Website
ceb: As of 2026, ang Bukidnon State University (BukSU) adunay team sa mga vice presidents nga nag-specialize sa lain-laing mga natad imbes usa ra ka vice president. Ang mga key officials mao ang mosunod:
Vice President for Academic Affairs: Dr. Hazel Jean M. Abejuela
Vice President for Research, Extension and Innovations: Dr. Carina Joane V. Barroso
Vice President for Administration and Finance: Mr. Dante S. Victoria, Jr.
Vice President for Culture, Arts, Sports and Student Services: Dr. Lincoln V. Tan
Si Dr. Joy M. Mirasol nagsilbi isip University President.
para sa dungag nga ipormasyon bisitaha anng official website sa BukSU
